data.name: Harshali
data.gender_notes: Harshali is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harshali is derived from the Sanskrit words harsh (mountain) and ali (waves), hence it means Mountain Waves. It is a beautiful and graceful name for a baby girl in Hindu culture. The name Harshali carries the meaning “Mountain Waves” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Harshali usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain waves and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Harshali represents the strength and beauty of nature and the grace of the divine. It is a name that inspires courage and resilience, and evokes feelings of peace and tranquility.
data.etymology: Harshali belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain Waves.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harshali total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
